established: Iterative decompression (brotli->gzip->identity looping to max_depth=5) restores decompression-normalization under triple-brotli encoding for ALL auth states including valid_token success body on localhost mock server with deterministic brotli quality 6: decompressed_body_only_discrimination 0.5 >= 0.3 for JSON/HTML/XML x 1KB/10KB/100KB, decompressed hash determinism all_same=true, B-RANDOM=0.0.

Triple-brotli encoding (brotli(brotli(brotli(body)))) is successfully decompressed by iterative depth 5 for ALL auth states including valid_token: 108 observations (27 valid_token + 81 error states), 0 decompression errors, all decompressed hashes match single-layer hashes. The parent V1 coverage gap (valid_token triple-br 0/180) is definitively closed.
Double-brotli for all auth states verified: decompressed hash determinism all_same=true, discrimination 0.5 across all 9 content-type x size combinations.

Iterative decompression introduces no regressions: single-layer scenarios (correct_br, missing_ce, incorrect_gzip, garbled_ce) maintain identical decompressed hashes, discrimination 0.5, all_same=true.
Decompression latency minimal: 0.012-0.27ms per response, scaling with decompressed size. No crashes/hangs from garbled Content-Encoding headers.
Compressed-only brotli discrimination 0.2781 < 0.3 confirms decompression is necessary for format-invariance (exceeds B-COMPRESSED-BYTE-ONLY baseline from parent).
Parent baselines exceeded: B-SINGLE-PASS-0.2911 and B-NO-DOUBLE-BR-0.4486 both exceeded by decompressed 0.5.
rejected: Single-pass client decompression does NOT survive double-brotli or triple-brotli encoding (parent established, this experiment confirms iterative fix resolves it).
Compressed-only body hashing is NOT sufficient for format-invariant discrimination (0.2781 < 0.3).

recommended_action: Design a real-CDN decompression-normalization experiment using Cloudflare Workers or Fastly Compute@Edge as a CDN proxy in front of the localhost mock server. The CDN proxy should apply real brotli/gzip compression with Accept-Encoding negotiation, chunked transfer-encoding, and caching. Test all 4 auth states x JSON/HTML/XML x 1KB/10KB/100KB with iterative decompression max_depth=5. The frozen decision rules from this experiment (C_STRATIFIED_COVERAGE, C_DECOMPRESSED_DISCRIMINATION, C_DECOMPRESSED_DETERMINISM, C_SINGLE_LAYER_NO_REGRESSION, C_LATENCY, C_NO_ERROR_INFLATION, C_COMPRESSED_BASELINE) can be reused.
